name: Batelapine
summary: Batelapine (developmental code name CGS-13429) is a structural analogue of clozapine which was investigated as a potential antipsychotic.

uses.text: Batelapine (developmental code name CGS-13429) is a structural analogue of clozapine which was investigated as a potential antipsychotic.

fact.en: It is a close structural relative of clozapine, the drug that reopened the field of antipsychotics in the 1970s by working where others had failed.
fact.zh: 它的結構與氯氮平極為相近，而氯氮平正是 1970 年代在其他藥物失效處仍然有效、從而重新開啟抗精神病藥領域的藥物。
fact.zhHans: 它的结构与氯氮平极为相近，而氯氮平正是 1970 年代在其他药物失效处仍然有效、从而重新打开抗精神病药领域的药物。
